propositions: Establish a provider-neutral bridge noun with functional preview (read-only, no mutation) and sync (mutating) subcommands as the first stage of verb migration.
Preserve all legacy top-level commands (reconcile, jira-onboard, bridge-probe, bridge-fsck, rebar doctor) and their existing consumers without breaking changes at the story boundary.
Prevent placeholder or unimplemented verbs from being advertised on main; defer setup, check-access, fsck, status, pause, and resume to their respective implementation stories.
Maintain mode.py's MODE_CAPS, Mode ladder, and gated_mode round-trip compatibility for MCP and phase-gate consumers.
Ensure nested bridge subcommand dispatch does not fall through to top-level commands and handles group/help/unknown-verb behavior explicitly.
Update user guide, CLI reference, and release notes to document only the staged surface (preview, sync) that ships, while preserving documentation of legacy commands.
